name: deck_history
description: A bundle's versions (SPEC §8): each change its history keeps, by author and time, oldest first, each named by its number as listed or by its id. With `at`, the deck as it was just after one (`scn` for source); with `compare`, what changed from one version to another, or, with one, to the deck as it is now: each state added, removed, or changed (its own fields, and its nodes as `deck_diff` says them), the deck's own fields, and the data files whose bytes changed; with `restore`, that version made the deck again, with its data files as they were: one change, refused as a patch is where the deck would not validate in the bundle as it is (`dry_run` writes nothing).

bundle.description:
The bundle: a directory, a `.scaena` zip, or a `deck.json`. Its history is
`history/deck.loro`, which `scaena save --history` begins.

at.description: The deck as it was in this version: its number as listed (`3`), or its id.

compare.description:
What changed from the first version to the second, or, with one, to the deck as it is
now, state by state.

restore.description: Make this version the deck again, with its data files as they were: one change.

dry_run.description: With `restore`, say what it would change, and write nothing.

Version.description: A version of the deck: as it was just after one change its history keeps.

n.description: Its place in the history, oldest first, from 1.

id.description: What names it for as long as the history lasts: its change's id, `counter@peer`.

message.description: What the change did, as what made it says.

at.description: When it was made, in RFC 3339, UTC.

ops.description: How many operations it holds: a character typed is one.

Seen.description: A version, and the deck as it was then: what `scaena history --at` prints.

deck.description: The deck as it was, canonical.

scn.description: With `scn`, the deck as it was, as `.scn` (SPEC §4).

files.description: The data files its sources name that the history held then, by their paths.

Compared.description: What changed from one version of the deck to another: what `scaena history --diff` prints.

to.description: The later version; none for the deck as it is now.

states.description: Each state that changed, by id: in the later version's order, then those it lacks.

deck.description:
The deck's own fields that changed (its theme, canvas, formats, fonts, data sources,
spine, …), each as the later version has it; null where it is gone. `order` is the
later version's states, where those both have run in another order.

files.description: The data files whose bytes changed, by their paths.

StateChange.description: What changed in one state from one version of the deck to another.

oneOf.description: The later version has it, and the earlier did not.
The earlier version had it, and the later does not.
Both have it, and it shows otherwise.

Changed.description: What changed in a state both versions have.

fields.description:
Its own fields that changed (its layout, transition, choreography, hold, notes, …),
each as the later version has it; null where it is gone.

nodes.description:
The nodes it shows that changed, resolved with the deck's overrides, as `diff` says them:
one that enters, with its props; one that exits; one whose props change, each as the
later version has it, and null where it is gone.

Change.description: What changes from one state to another, resolved, by node.

oneOf.description: It stays, and these props change.

Restored.description: What restoring a version did, or would do: what `scaena history --restore` prints.

applied.description: Whether the bundle was written: not on a dry run, nor when the version is refused.

files.description: The data files written as the version held them, by their paths.

added.description: What `validate` and `lint` find after that they did not before.

removed.description: What they found before that they do not after.

errors.description: The findings that are errors, after.

states.description: The states it changes what shows in, by id, as `patch` says them.

Finding.description: One lint finding, shaped for agents: a code, a JSON pointer, and (when safe) a fix.

file.description: The bundle file `path` points into, when it is not `deck.json` (a theme file).

format.description: The format the deck was laid out in (`"9:16"`), when it is not the deck's own.

fix.description: A JSON Patch (RFC 6902) that resolves the finding. Only safe, non-content fixes.

versions.description: Its versions, oldest first, when nothing else is asked.
